body: Worker rule (Termal::BarA1, from Fable2 #812, 2026-10-23 15:55Z, after my own w-650b request to Engram::Fable). When asking another project for timing or diagnostic evidence, ask ONLY for what its own tools and logs already expose: diagnostics files, its MCP or its CLI. Never ask for, or suggest, a direct query against a live store; never run one myself either. That covers Engram's stores and ~/.termal/*.sqlite alike. My request for "store-lock or transaction timing" led Engram::Fable to run a read-only Python sqlite query on Engram's two live stores at 15:40:42Z. It never returned, and Windows hung within about a minute; that is time-adjacent only, recorded on w-3be56ef0b931. If a split needs store-level timing, name it as a missing measurement point and stop there.
